notes:
## New features & enhancements

- A station name too long for the readout now fades in and out at the edges as it scrolls, instead of being cut off against a hard line. Each edge softens only while the name is actually passing it, so the first and last words are never dimmed while you are reading them.
- The segment, split-flap and 8-bit faces keep their hard edge on purpose: those displays are made of cells, which are lit or not, and a fade would read as a photograph of a screen rather than as the screen.
- A long name returns to its start about 1.7 times quicker once it reaches the end, so there is less waiting before it reads again.
- The "Add station" key now sizes its own label to fit its button, instead of being cut short on the faces set in a wide display type.
- Enhancements to seasonal themes.

## Bug fixes

- A station added from the search and then deleted in the same sitting is offered again. Its button stayed on "Added" and greyed out, and only running the search afresh would bring it back.
- A station found through the search now shows its stream address rather than offering it for editing. It is the one part of such a station already known to work. A station you add by hand still has an address you can type.
- Fixes in seasonal themes.
